display_information.name: FaultMaven
display_information.description: AI troubleshooting copilot that runs the investigation, not just answers.
display_information.long_description:
FaultMaven is an AI troubleshooting copilot that works a problem the way a seasoned engineer does — and never forgets what it learns.

Hand it an error, a log, or a config and it doesn't just answer — it runs the investigation: triages the symptom, forms hypotheses, asks for the specific data that will confirm or eliminate each one, and keeps going until the root cause is found and the fix is verified.

How it works a case:
• Goal-driven — every turn moves the case toward a solution, not just a reply
• Methodical — triage, hypotheses, targeted data requests, verified fix; no jumping to conclusions
• Evidence-based — it reads your logs, errors, and configs, draws on your runbooks and past fixes, and shows the evidence behind every step
• Self-learning — when a case is resolved, it can capture the fix as a runbook, turning the experience into knowledge the next investigation starts from

You stay in command: it suggests, you approve and execute. And it only joins where you invite it — @mention it in a channel thread, run "Ask FaultMaven" on any alert or error message, or start a direct conversation. Once it's in a thread, just reply to keep the investigation going; each problem gets its own thread, so separate investigations stay separate.

IMPORTANT — AI ACCURACY: FaultMaven is powered by large language models. Its output — including its triage, hypotheses, data requests, and proposed fixes — may be incomplete, misleading, or inaccurate, and it can be confidently wrong. Treat every response as a suggestion to verify, not an authoritative answer, and review it before acting on production systems. FaultMaven proposes; you approve and execute.

IMPORTANT — PAID SLACK PLAN REQUIRED FOR THE AI AGENT CONTAINER: Slack's AI agent container (the dedicated assistant panel that opens alongside your conversation) is a paid Slack feature, so reaching FaultMaven there requires a paid Slack subscription (Pro, Business+, or Enterprise Grid). FaultMaven's other surfaces do not depend on it: @mentioning FaultMaven in a channel thread and the "Ask FaultMaven" message shortcut work on any Slack plan, including free — so a free workspace can still run full investigations.

assistant_view.assistant_description: I find a problem's root cause the way a seasoned engineer would — triage, hypotheses, targeted data requests, a verified fix — grounded in your logs, errors, configs, runbooks, and past fixes. You approve and execute; you stay in control.
